prose: Jackie Jolie joins InnerVerse to discuss her journey from sickness to health, using the light of the sun to reprogram her body for optimal wellness. We'll discover her backstory with lyme disease and the medical establishment's failure to fix it, how modern artificial light is affecting us, and the strategies you can employ to enhance your alignment to nature's circadian biorhythms and experience enlightening rejuvenation.
